did_you_know: A wain is a large cart pulled by farm animals.
description: Depicting Dobbs Ferry, NY, a village overlooking the Hudson River, Landscape with Haywain presents a peaceful view of a grain harvest. Artist Worthington Whittredge created this work during the same year the Civil War started, and the American flag hanging beside the farmhouse may reference the Union cause.
